{{Top|leg}}
A '''remote droid''' was a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was used in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] a group of these [[Droid/Legends|droids]] broke into the [[Kothlis spynet facility]] during [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|invasion]] of the [[Kothlis/Legends|planet]] and attacked [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Although Kenobi was rescued by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|Clone Lieutenant]] [[Treve]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]].
